nrp_nerve_eze.name: Nerve Eze

nrp_nerve_eze.src: NutriDyn sell sheet Nerve Eze SS ND633, Rev. 8/24 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/, id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAtRRg), read into scratchpad labels/labels.json: 1 capsule = PEA (Levagen+) 300 mg + alpha lipoic acid (ALA) 150 mg; directions 'Take one capsule twice daily'; caution 'If you are pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use.' nrp_gluco_ir.name: Gluco IR
nrp_gluco_ir.key: Per 5 capsules: 100 mg dihydroberberine, 300 mg ALA, 600 mcg chromium, 2,000 mcg biotin, 500 mg Ceylon cinnamon, plus fenugreek, stinging nettle, bitter melon, gymnema, green tea and banaba
nrp_gluco_ir.src: Full panel: NutriDyn sell sheet Gluco IR SS ND506, Rev. 11/25 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Gluco IR SS ND506.pdf, id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAA2Chg), read with the Dropbox fetch tool 2026-11-03. Supplement Facts, serving 5 capsules, 30 servings, eleven actives in printed order (amounts paired in printed order; the two %DV figures check: biotin 2,000 mcg = 6,667% of 30 mcg, chromium 600 mcg = 1,714% of 35 mcg): biotin 2,000 mcg; chromium (as chromium picolinate) 600 mcg; Ceylon cinnamon powder (bark) 500 mg; stinging nettle powder (leaf) 500 mg; fenugreek extract (seed) 500 mg; alpha lipoic acid 300 mg; bitter melon extract (fruit) 250 mg; green tea extract (leaf; 80% polyphenols, 75% catechins, 30% EGCG) 200 mg; Gymnema sylvestre extract (leaf) 200 mg; dihydroberberine (GlucoVantage) 100 mg; banaba extract (leaf, 1% corosolic acid) 50 mg. Directions 'Take five capsules daily'; caution 'If pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use.' The printed line gives amounts for the five headline actives and names the six botanicals (stinging nettle and bitter melon added 2026-11-03 so the line is the whole formula). Nine of the eleven amounts also match the product DB: scratchpad products/nutridyn_products.json R960 (NutriDyn catalog ND143 10/1/26 as read by the switch charts): Ortho Molecular Diaxinol row 'alpha lipoic acid NutriDyn 300 mg (5 capsules); chromium 600 mcg; biotin 2,000 mcg; cinnamon NutriDyn 500 mg Ceylon cinnamon powder'; Metagenics Insinase row 'NutriDyn 5 capsules = dihydroberberine 100 mg, chromium 600 mcg, biotin 2,000 mcg, Ceylon cinnamon 500 mg, alpha lipoic acid 300 mg'; Metagenics MetaGlycemX row adds green tea leaf extract 200 mg; DFH GlucoSupreme Herbal row adds fenugreek 500 mg, gymnema 200 mg, banaba 50 mg; directions 'Take five capsules daily'; SKU R960 150C = 30 servings (Metagenics row). Same amounts in products/needs.md line 45 (its vitamin C 300 mg, vitamin E 134 mg and B12 150 mcg belong to the Metagenics side of the MetaGlycemX row, which says NutriDyn has 'none beyond chromium and biotin', so they are left out). The repo blast blasts/2026-09-22-gluco-ir-back.html gives the dihydroberberine form (GlucoVantage, left off the printed line for space), 'Five capsules: dihydroberberine, chromium, biotin, Ceylon cinnamon, alpha-lipoic acid and six more', the qualifier 'Promotes healthy blood glucose levels already in the normal range' and the URL. The 3 + 2 split with meals is the sheet's schedule, copied from products.py gluco_ir (sheet-local key so the shared gluco_ir line other sheets print is untouched).

nrp_b12_pro.name: B12 Pro
nrp_b12_pro.key: Per tablet: 5,000 mcg vitamin B12 as methylcobalamin, quick-dissolve
nrp_b12_pro.dosesub: let it dissolve in your mouth
nrp_b12_pro.src: NutriDyn sell sheet B12 Pro SS ND1390, (c)2025 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/B12 Pro SS ND1390.pdf, id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAA0JMg), read with the Dropbox fetch tool 2026-11-03: Supplement Facts, serving 1 quick-dissolve tablet, 60 servings, vitamin B12 (as methylcobalamin) 5,000 mcg, 208,333% DV (= 5,000 / 2.4 mcg); directions 'Take one quick-dissolve tablet daily or as directed'; caution 'If you are pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use'; the sheet calls methylcobalamin 'the active coenzyme form of B12' and says the tablet absorbs 'through the body's mucous membranes' (so: let it dissolve in your mouth). Same amount in the product DB scratchpad products/nutridyn_products.json R2181 (NutriDyn catalog ND143 10/1/26 as read by the NuMedica, Nutri-West, Biotics Research and Apex switch charts): 'Vitamin B12 as methylcobalamin per serving: NutriDyn 5,000 mcg (1 quick-dissolve tablet)'; directions 'Take one quick-dissolve tablet by mouth per day'; SKU R2181 60T. No verified product-page slug, so the link falls back to the nutridyn.com catalog search.

nrp_methyl_complete.name: Methyl Complete
nrp_methyl_complete.key: Per 2 capsules: 1 mg B12 (methyl + adenosyl), 10 mg B6 (as P5P), 30 mg B2 (as R5P), 800 mcg DFE folate (L-5-MTHF), 500 mcg biotin, 5 mg zinc, 700 mg TMG, 500 mg NAC, 25 mg intrinsic factor (from pork)
nrp_methyl_complete.src: Full panel: NutriDyn sell sheet Methyl Complete SS ND420, Rev. 9/24 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Methyl Complete SS ND420.pdf, id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAqjqA), read with the Dropbox fetch tool 2026-11-03. Supplement Facts, serving 2 capsules, 60 servings, nine actives in printed order, each amount paired with its printed %DV and checked against the FDA Daily Value: riboflavin (as riboflavin 5'-phosphate, R5P) 30 mg = 2,308% of 1.3 mg; vitamin B6 (as pyridoxal 5'-phosphate, P5P) 10 mg = 588% of 1.7 mg; folate (as calcium L-5-methyltetrahydrofolate, BioFolate) 800 mcg DFE = 200% of 400 mcg; vitamin B12 (as methylcobalamin and adenosylcobalamin) 1 mg = 41,667% of 2.4 mcg; biotin 500 mcg = 1,667% of 30 mcg; zinc (as zinc bisglycinate chelate, Albion) 5 mg = 45% of 11 mg; trimethylglycine 700 mg; N-acetyl-L-cysteine 500 mg; intrinsic factor (porcine) 25 mg (no DV). Directions 'Take two capsules once daily or as directed by your healthcare practitioner'; caution 'If you are pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use.' The printed line lists all nine (riboflavin, biotin, zinc and intrinsic factor added 2026-11-03; 'from pork' because the label's 'porcine' matters to anyone who avoids pork). The same amounts are in the product DB scratchpad products/nutridyn_products.json R187 (NutriDyn catalog ND143 10/1/26 as read by the switch charts): riboflavin 30 mg in the DFH Homocysteine Supreme, Ortho Methyl CpG, Metagenics Methyl Care, Thorne Methyl-Guard Plus ('B2 (riboflavin 5'-phosphate) 30 mg'), Klaire Methyl Balance and Apex Methyl-SP rows and in products/needs.md line 90; zinc 5 mg in the Metagenics Methyl Care row; biotin 500 mcg in the Nutri-West Methyl Renew row; trimethylglycine (TMG) 700 mg, folate (L-5-MTHF) 800 mcg DFE, B12 1 mg (methylcobalamin and adenosylcobalamin), B6 (pyridoxal 5'-phosphate, P5P) 10 mg and N-acetyl-L-cysteine (NAC) 500 mg in the Pure Homocysteine Factors row; directions 'Take two capsules once daily'; SKU R187 120C. Intrinsic factor appears only on the sell sheet. URL slug from products.py SLUGS (NutriDyn 60-day protocol doc); 'with breakfast' from products.py methyl_b. Sheet-local key so this sheet can keep numbers and units together without changing the shared methyl_b line.

nrp_omega.name: Omega Pure EPA‑DHA 1000
nrp_omega.key: Per softgel: 1,000 mg EPA + DHA (730 mg EPA, 270 mg DHA)
nrp_omega.src: NutriDyn sell sheet Omega Pure EPA-DHA 1000 SS ND416, Rev. 4/25 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Omega Pure EPA-DHA 1000 SS ND416.pdf, id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAyHow), read with the Dropbox fetch tool 2026-11-03: Supplement Facts, serving 1 softgel, 120 servings: total omega-3 fatty acids 1.1 g, EPA 730 mg, DHA 270 mg, additional omega-3s 100 mg; directions 'Take one softgel 1-3 times daily with food'; contains fish (anchovy, sardine, mackerel), gelatin softgel; caution 'If you are pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use.' Same amounts in the product DB scratchpad products/nutridyn_products.json R243 (NutriDyn catalog ND143 10/1/26 as read by the Pure, DFH, Ortho, Metagenics, Integrative Therapeutics, NuMedica, Nutri-West and Biotics switch charts): EPA 730 mg + DHA 270 mg = 1,000 mg per softgel; directions 'Take one softgel up to three times daily with food'; SKU R243 120S. One softgel with the evening meal is the sheet's plan, inside the label directions (same as products.py omega_1000). URL slug from products.py SLUGS. Sheet-local key only so the name and amounts never break between a number and its unit (non-breaking hyphen and space in the name).
